summary: Completed backend contract and frontend workflow testing for Frameforge Studio.

integration_issues.issue: The play/pause IconButton inside Preview has an empty onClick handler; the separate lower playback button works, but the visible player control is non-functional.
Projects nav button only displays a notice and does not open a projects list/view, despite project persistence endpoints being present.

action_items: Wire the Preview section play/pause IconButton to the same playing state as the lower playback control.
Implement a Projects view or clearly scope the Projects nav as unavailable; current behavior is only a notice.
critical_code_review_comments: Render intentionally returns queue status with download_url null; this is MOCKED and does not create an MP4.
Ollama fallback generation is MOCKED/deterministic when Ollama is offline and should remain clearly communicated to users.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core workflow checks; 2 integration gaps reported

seed_data_creation: No seed data created; tests used the existing seed project and a render-only payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop/mobile studio, prompt, fast mode, SSE completion, scene editing, add/delete, playback/scrubber, save/export notices, settings, health, and mobile overflow were tested. Ollama was offline but health fallback was valid.
rca of the issue: Preview's upper IconButton is rendered with onClick={() => {}} in App.js, so it cannot change playing state. Projects navigation similarly uses onClick={() => setNotice(...)} and has no projects view state or fetch flow.
